desc: SilencerCo’s Omega 36M is a lightweight, compact, modular suppressor built for centerfire rifles. In its full configuration, the Omega 36M weighs 16.3 ounces and is 7.6 inches long, providing extreme noise reduction. This SiCo suppressor can also be reduced to a short configuration, at 5.75 inches and 13.6 ounces for optimal maneuverability. Constructed of highly durable stainless steel, the SiCo Omega 36M can be run on magnum rifles, 9mm pistols, and sub guns. This multi-caliber suppressor can accommodate up to 338 Lapua, making the Omega 36M unique and highly versatile.
